title: From Representational Harms to Quality-of-Service Harms: A Case Study on Llama 2 Safety Safeguards
findings: Llama 2 models exhibit disparate safety behaviors for prompts involving religious groups. Prompts with Muslim names have the highest rates of both 'refusal to answer' and 'harmful refusal' compared to other demographic groups, including Jewish and White names. This indicates that the model's safety safeguards disproportionately affect this group, creating quality-of-service harms by masking underlying harmful associations under the guise of safety.
